note: The input font's morx table bytes become the AAT morx object used by shaping.
The morx table controls how many chains are applied from the input-controlled table data.
The selected morx chain subtable is dispatched, reaching the contextual subtable carried in this candidate.
The input-controlled contextual state machine is supplied to the state table driver.

code: unsigned int entry = states[state * nClasses + klass];
note: The entry index fetched from the input-controlled state array must designate a sanitized entry table element before it is dereferenced.
The unchecked entry pointer returned from the contextual machine is propagated into transition processing.
The transition reads a 16-bit field through the propagated entry pointer, producing the target out-of-bounds BEInt read when the entry is outside the valid table.
